newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO seeks Israeli help to control Ramallah fire.
newsitem.headline: PLO seeks Israeli help to control Ramallah fire.

text.p: PLO police sought Israeli help to extinguish a fire which engulfed two Palestinian factories in an industrial area of self-ruled Ramallah on Sunday, witnesses said.

They said a sponge factory caught fire on Sunday morning, destroying all its equipment and products worth more than $10 million. The fire spread to a nearby clothing factory before it could be controlled. No one was hurt in the blaze.

"The Palestinian firemen could not extinguish the fire, it was so big it began spreading, so the Palestinian police requested help from the Israeli liaison officers to send fire engines from Israel to help put out the fire," one witness said.
Several Israeli fire engines arrived in Ramallah from Jerusalem.
Israel handed over parts of the West Bank, including Ramallah, to Palestinian rule last year in line with PLO-Israeli peace deals.
"Before the Israeli and Palestinian firemen began to control the fire, it had already spread to another clothing factory in the area," the witness said.
Workers at the sponge factory said they believed that high temperatures had caused chemicals to ignite.
